questions.question: Where does Matołek want to get to at the beginning?
questions.explanation: He sets off for Pacanów to get horseshoes.

questions.question: Who does Matołek meet on the Moon?
questions.explanation: On the Moon he meets Mr. Twardowski.

questions.question: What does Matołek lose in the town with the strange law?
questions.explanation: In the town where beards are forbidden, they cut off his beard.

questions.question: Where does Matołek finally stay?
answers: In Poland, among his own people
questions.explanation: He says: "I will stay! I will never leave Poland again."

questions.question: Who sews Matołek's head back on after he loses his beard?
questions.explanation: A kind cobbler sews his head back onto his body.
